title: A package's source weeks
description: data/packages/<id>/source_weeks.yaml: the source's own example weeks and progressions, transcribed, each generated under the profile the source assumes and compared field by field (src/source_weeks.py; scorecard S5). A field left out is the source's silence and is never compared. Read by the scorecard, never at runtime.

rule.description: The rule of fidelity.yaml this pins.

note.description: Where in the source, and how it was transcribed.

profile.description: Constraints over the fidelity defaults (three days, 60 minutes, intermediate, all equipment); `equipment: all` is every implement. Contract inputs (starting_loads_kg, five_rep_max_kg …) go here too.

from_week.description: The program week the first entry of `weeks` is (default 1).

round_kg.description: The plates the contract loads: a source's kilograms (any *_kg field) are compared rounded to this, half up — 80 % of 90 kg is 72, loaded as 72.5.

num_weeks.description: Weeks to generate (default: as many as `weeks` reaches).

modalities.description: Sessions in the week per modality, where the source counts them rather than placing them (tests aside).

days.description: The training days in order; with any `rest` entry, the week's seven days from Monday.

field.description: A field of the assignment's load (weight_kg, reps_per_round, target_rounds …).

series.description: One field of one exercise over the successive sessions that carry it.

exercises.description: The work exercises in order; an object adds the numbers the source gives (sets, reps, weight_kg, rest_sec …), read from the assignment's load.

includes.description: Exercises the session has, in any order, with the numbers the source gives — for a source that names some of a session, not all of it.
